scope: Provenance of artwork in the Ema theme. The theme ships no third-party images: the official character sprites and cut-in, the three manga excerpts, the key visual and the portrait crops recorded here earlier were removed from public/ on 2026-11-13 and remain only in the Git history. Until cleared artwork exists, Ema's homepage figure is a labelled placeholder drawn in code and the owner's avatar is the monogram 旭. New artwork is recorded here before it enters public/ (docs/ART-DIRECTION.md). This file is not a permission or license grant. Third-party media are excluded from the repository software license.
non_ai_processing: No generative AI, image synthesis, generative fill, redrawing, or upscaling is used.
